_om: Kameleonen in English (The Chameleon, rusj.no/en/the-chameleon/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Scenes and emotions are in data.en/innhold.json, written for the UK. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Ny følelse hvert 10.–18. sekund. Fint fo: A new feeling every 10–18 seconds. Good for little ones.
Ny følelse hvert 4.–9. sekund. Hold dere: A new feeling every 4–9 seconds. Hold on tight!
To spiller en scene. Mobilen bestemmer f: Two act out a scene. The phone decides the feeling – and switches it when you least expect it.
Mobilen velger to skuespillere og en sce: The phone picks two actors and a scene, for example ‘Dentist and patient’. Everyone else is the audience.
Mobilen viser en følelse. Når den piper: The phone shows a feeling. When it beeps and changes colour, you switch to the new one at once – mid-sentence.
Når tiden er ute, velger publikum hvem s: When time is up, the audience picks who was best: two points. Just as good? One point each.
Legg mobilen der skuespillerne ser den,: Put the phone where the actors can see it, or let someone in the audience hold it up.
Hver runde spiller alle to scener – med: Each round, everyone acts in two scenes – with two different partners.
Velg «Rolig» når de minste er med, og «K: Choose ‘Calm’ when little ones are playing, and ‘Chaos’ once you've warmed up.
Trykket feil? «Angre» tar dommen tilbake: Tapped the wrong one? ‘Undo’ takes the verdict back before the next scene.
Ingen ord er feil i impro. Si ja til det: Nothing is wrong in improv. Say yes to whatever the other one comes up with, and build on it!
Switch the feeling when the phone beeps.
To spiller, resten er publikum. Alle får: Two act, the rest are the audience. Everyone gets a go.
Each round, everyone acts in two scenes.
Følg følelsen på mobilen. Når den piper,: Follow the feeling on the phone. When it beeps, you switch – straight away!
Publikum bestemmer. Best gir to poeng, l: The audience decides. Best gets two points, just as good gets one each.
Dere går rett til kåringen. Den med fles: You go straight to the results. Whoever has the most points wins.
Ingen har fått poeng ennå, så det blir i: Nobody has any points yet, so there won't be any results.
